key_findings: Finding 1: TARGET_MEASURED (abliterated) checkpoint fabricates a fictional stock price instead of abstaining (4/5 seeds fail); BASE and POSTTRAINED both correctly abstain.
Finding 2: POSTTRAINED (official, non-abliterated) fails DB-vs-simulation discrimination, the project's most structurally important axis; BASE and TARGET_MEASURED both pass.

Finding 3: all failures across 24 extended-pilot cases cluster on unknowable-fact fabrication and epistemic-label imprecision (MEASUREMENT_ERROR collapsed into HYPOTHESIS, 0/5 seeds), not structural/procedural reasoning, which was 100% correct.
Finding 4: instruction-following exactness is 100% under greedy decoding but drops to 40% under temperature=0.7 sampling (formatting drift, not semantic failure).

Finding 5: causal steering probe (layer 11) shows a real, reproducible behavioral effect (sign-flip/lesion/permute behave as predicted); the representation-divergence submetric is broken due to a suspected hook/output_hidden_states instrumentation mismatch on this architecture -- documented as known_issue, not used as evidence.
Finding 6: resource envelope is uniform across all 3 candidates (~2GB RSS, ~5-8 tok/s CPU-only); not a discriminating factor for checkpoint choice.
coordinator_hypothesis: Neither the abliterated nor the official checkpoint is a clean choice on current evidence -- each fails a different axis this project cares about, each on n=1. Enlarging Finding 1 and Finding 2's sample size is a higher-value next step than Phase 11 (HCU/variable-N) or cross-encoding.
coordinator_recommendation_next: Enlarge matched-baseline sample size on the abstain-calibration axis (Finding 1) and DB-vs-simulation axis (Finding 2) beyond n=1 per candidate before any checkpoint selection.
Fix the representation-divergence instrumentation bug (capture hidden state inside the forward hook, not via output_hidden_states) before citing any J-Space representation-level number.
Design Phase 11 (HCU/variable-N) as its own scoping task -- define a concrete, testable logical-N interface before attempting to measure it; do not build a sweep target under time pressure.
